name.value: Dispensing device

description.value:
The Spenser unit that is to dispense this order, named by a logical reference: the unit's identifier in http://costateixeira.github.io/spenser/unit, which is its name, Spenser- and the last two bytes of its factory MAC.
R5 has no element on MedicationRequest for this. MedicationRequest.performer and MedicationRequest.device take a DeviceDefinition, a kind of device, and dispenseRequest.dispenser takes only an Organization. A logical reference needs nothing on the server: the unit does not have to be registered as a Device for the order to name it.
When a Task makes the order actionable, a Device in Task.requestedPerformer takes precedence over this extension. On an order with no Task, or a Task that names no unit, a unit acts on this extension: it skips an order that names another unit.

description.value: The Device a unit writes on the order server once per boot. Its id is the unit's name, the network it shows in setup mode: Spenser- and the last two bytes of its factory MAC.

description.value: What Spenser creates on the order server once a piece has come out, pointing back at the order in authorizingPrescription. The same resource is the answer to an order posted straight at the device.

valueString.value: O que o Spenser cria no servidor de prescrições depois de sair um pedaço, apontando de volta para a prescrição em authorizingPrescription. O mesmo recurso é a resposta a uma prescrição publicada diretamente no dispositivo.

Wat Spenser op de orderserver aanmaakt zodra er een stukje is uitgekomen, met in authorizingPrescription een verwijzing terug naar de order. Dezelfde resource is het antwoord op een order die rechtstreeks naar het apparaat wordt gepost.

Ce que Spenser crée sur le serveur d'ordonnances une fois qu'un morceau est sorti, en renvoyant à l'ordonnance dans authorizingPrescription. La même ressource est la réponse à une ordonnance envoyée directement à l'appareil.

description.value: An order Spenser could not fill because the lane is empty. R5 removed MedicationDispense.statusReason, so the reason lives in notPerformedReason, which is a CodeableReference - hence the .concept in the path.

valueString.value: Uma prescrição que o Spenser não conseguiu aviar porque a calha está vazia. O R5 removeu MedicationDispense.statusReason, pelo que o motivo fica em notPerformedReason, que é um CodeableReference - daí o .concept no caminho.

Een order die Spenser niet kon uitvoeren omdat de baan leeg is. R5 heeft MedicationDispense.statusReason verwijderd, dus de reden staat in notPerformedReason, een CodeableReference - vandaar de .concept in het pad.

Une ordonnance que Spenser n'a pas pu exécuter parce que le couloir est vide. R5 a supprimé MedicationDispense.statusReason : le motif se trouve donc dans notPerformedReason, qui est un CodeableReference - d'où le .concept dans le chemin.

description.value: A MedicationRequest the placer has marked actionable. Spenser dispenses it on its next check and, because no Task is coordinating the work, sets the request itself to completed.

Een MedicationRequest die de plaatser als uitvoerbaar heeft gemarkeerd. Spenser verstrekt ze bij zijn volgende controle en zet, omdat geen Task het werk coördineert, de aanvraag zelf op completed.
Une MedicationRequest que l'émetteur a marquée comme exécutable. Spenser la dispense à sa prochaine vérification et, comme aucune Task ne coordonne le travail, passe lui-même la demande à completed.

Dezelfde order zonder de tag. Op zichzelf is dit een machtiging en niets meer: Spenser negeert ze tot een Task vraagt om ze uit te voeren.
La même ordonnance sans le tag. À elle seule, c'est une autorisation et rien de plus : Spenser l'ignore jusqu'à ce qu'une Task demande son exécution.

description.value: An order made actionable by the tag, with no Task, that names the unit to dispense it in the dispensingDevice extension. Every other unit polling the server skips it.

description.value: Task.requestedPerformer names the unit that is to fill the order: the one Task element R5 lets name a Device. Every other unit skips this Task; the unit it names dispenses it and closes it.

description.value: A Coordination Task pointing at the order in Task.focus. This is what makes the plain order actionable. Spenser completes the Task with the dispense in Task.output, and leaves the request itself to the placer.

valueString.value: Uma Task de coordenação que aponta para a prescrição em Task.focus. É isto que torna acionável a prescrição simples. O Spenser conclui a Task com a dispensa em Task.output e deixa a própria MedicationRequest ao emissor.

Een coördinerende Task die in Task.focus naar de order verwijst. Dit maakt de gewone order uitvoerbaar. Spenser voltooit de Task met de verstrekking in Task.output, en laat de aanvraag zelf aan de plaatser over.

Une Task de coordination qui pointe vers l'ordonnance dans Task.focus. C'est ce qui rend l'ordonnance simple exécutable. Spenser termine la Task avec la dispensation dans Task.output, et laisse la demande elle-même à l'émetteur.
